newsitem.title: DENMARK: East Asiatic, BASF in Thai venture.
newsitem.headline: East Asiatic, BASF in Thai venture.

text.p: Denmark's wholesale and graphics group East Asiatic and Germany's BASF said on Friday they intended to establish a joint venture company for the marketing and sales of dyes and other chemicals for the textile industry in Thailand.
They said that the company, to be named BASF Asiatic Colours and Chemicals Co Ltd., was expected to be operational in August this year.
"The new joint venture will supply the total range of textile dyes and chemicals previously supplied by EAC and BASF Thai Ltd," East Asiatic and BASF said in a statement.
"It will combine the local technical marketing expertise and laboratory support of both companies to serve customers in (Thailand's) textile industry," they said.
